params.prompt: Clean medical infographic comparing stomach emptying times. Top title 'STOMACH EMPTYING TIME COMPARISON' in bold dark gray sans-serif. Two side-by-side simple bar charts. Left chart titled 'NORMAL' in blue (#2c6cb6) with a small stomach icon — a short horizontal blue bar showing '2-4 HOURS', caption underneath 'Healthy gastric motility — food clears in 2-4 hours'. Right chart titled 'ON GLP-1' in orange-red (#e85a3a) with a slowed-stomach icon — a much longer red-orange bar showing '10-14 HOURS' that extends nearly across the chart, caption underneath 'Disrupted gastric motility — food sits for 10-14 hours'. White background, clean vector flat design, minimalist, medical editorial infographic style. No 3D, no shadows, very flat clean illustration.
